digest.component_or_area: reconciler coordinator mutation routing and state lifecycle
propositions: Every supported Cloud/DC mutation must route through exactly one typed coordinator/adapter path with no hidden generic retry, _best_effort, duck-typed fallback, or legacy write wrapper reachable from production code.
Unsupported production actions must fail with a typed provider-neutral error before any local or remote effects occur.
Versioned manifest, preview, and log output must preserve existing mutation fields while adding redacted lifecycle intent, logical/physical attempt, delay/budget, disposition, and fuse state data.
Cursor, baseline, and binding state must advance only for proven postconditions; deferred, failed, skipped, and commit-unknown work must remain unapplied and recoverable in the next pass.

The repair_at_write_boundary call in reconcile.py must execute after staleness validation and before the first remote issue fetch, with test_repair_runs_before_the_first_remote_observation as the behavioral oracle.

Portable verified-fake Cloud/DC end-to-end test suites must cover retry envelope, fuse open/reset, create containment, transient recovery, deferral, permanent failure, and restart without external credentials.
